description: Replace the target channel's permission overwrites with a copy of the source channel's. The target's existing overwrites are overwritten. Requires the Manage Channels and Manage Roles permissions, and View Channel on the source: the tool refuses a source the bot cannot view, whose overwrites Discord may replace with a single @everyone View Channel deny. Returns a confirmation. To create a new channel with the same overwrites, use discord_clone_channel; to remove them all, use discord_reset_channel_permissions.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

source_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel to copy overwrites from.

target_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel whose overwrites will be replaced.

name: discord_copy_permissions
